title: A flat resolution whose ringed-topos pullback is K-flat
statement: Let $(C,J)$ and $(D,K)$ be sites essentially small in a fixed coefficient universe, let $R$ on $C$ and $S$ on $D$ be sheaves of commutative rings, and let $u^{-1}\dashv u_*$ be a morphism of their sheaf topoi, with $u^{-1}$ preserving finite limits. Fix its algebraic inverse image on ring and module sheaves and a ring homomorphism $c:u^{-1}R\to S$. Write $u^*$ for the additive module pullback, inverse image followed by extension of scalars [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], applied termwise to cochain complexes [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. For every complex $P$ of $R$-module sheaves, without flatness or K-flatness hypotheses on $P$, there exist a complex $L$ and a quasi-isomorphism $q:L\to P$ [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules] such that $L$ is K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex], each term of $L$ is flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], and $u^*L$ is K-flat.

proof.text: Choose a strictly compatible tower of bounded-above flat resolutions E_n of the good truncations of P, using [lem-pc-flat-truncation-tower]. Their degreewise colimit L carries a map q to P. Exact filtered colimits commute with homology, and the good truncations are eventually P in each degree. Thus q is a quasi-isomorphism.

Apply the proved independent-universe bounded-above flat criterion [lem-weil-pbc-independent-bounded-flat-kflat] directly to every E_n. Filtered colimits of K-flat complexes and of flat module sheaves remain K-flat and flat, respectively, by the tensor-colimit and exact-colimit argument of [lem-pc-module-filtered-colimits-tensor]. Thus their colimit L is K-flat with flat terms.

The specified module pullback preserves the degreewise filtered colimit and its differentials by [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-pullback-filtered-colimits]. Its terms on every E_n are flat by [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-flat-module-pullback]; additivity preserves zero terms and therefore boundedness above. The bounded-above flat criterion and filtered-colimit closure prove that its image of L is K-flat.

theorem exists_pullback_adapted_flat_resolution
    {C : Type uC} {D : Type uD} [Category.{vC} C] [Category.{vD} D]
    [EssentiallySmall.{w} C] [EssentiallySmall.{w} D]
    {JC : GrothendieckTopology C} {JD : GrothendieckTopology D}
    {R : Sheaf JC CommRingCat.{w}} {S RI : Sheaf JD CommRingCat.{w}}
    (uInv : Sheaf JC (Type (w)) ⥤ Sheaf JD (Type (w)))
    (uPush : Sheaf JD (Type (w)) ⥤ Sheaf JC (Type (w)))
    (adj : uInv ⊣ uPush) [PreservesFiniteLimits uInv]
    (I : AlgebraicInverseImage uInv R RI) (c : RI ⟶ S)
    (uStar : ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JC
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj R) ⥤
      ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JD
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj S))
    (hobj : ∀ M : ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JC
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj R),
      uStar.obj M = changeOfRings c (I.modules.obj M))
    (hmap : ∀ {M N : ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JC
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj R)} (a : M ⟶ N),
      uStar.map a = eqToHom (hobj M) ≫
        changeOfRingsHom c (I.modules.obj M) (I.modules.map a) ≫ eqToHom (hobj N).symm)
    [uStar.Additive]
    (P : CochainComplex (ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JC
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj R)) ℤ) :
    ∃ (L : CochainComplex (ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JC
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj R)) ℤ) (q : L ⟶ P),
      L.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, IsFlatOnSite (J := JC) (R := R) (L.X n)) ∧ QuasiIso q ∧
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
        ((uStar.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj L)
